learnings: Tool errors (LLM response errors, parse failures) should be handled with automatic retries rather than marking files as inconclusive
Advisory reports should be clearly separated from voting reports in the final verdict calculation
When one model successfully completes a full review and finds no issues, while other models fail due to tool errors, the successful review should carry more weight in the final verdict
The audit tool should distinguish between 'file is unsafe' and 'tool failed to analyze file' - these require different handling in verdict aggregation
